paite: Belshazzar kumpipa'n atoupate lak a mi sangkhat a ding in ankuang thupitak abawl a, sangkhatte ma ah uain adawn hi.
heading: Belshazzar Ankuangluina
english: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

paite: Belshazzar in uain achep lai in, apa Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a om tempul a kipan a alak dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuante kumpipa leh atoupate, azite leh ameite'n huaite a adawntheihna ding un hon la ding in thu apia hi.
english: Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem; that the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, might drink from them.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem a om Pathian inn, tempul a kipan alakkhiak dangka-eng tui-um belsuante ahon la ua; kumpipa leh atoupate, azite leh ameite'n, huaite in adawn uhi.
english: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of God’s house which was at Jerusalem; and the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, drank from them.

paite: Uain adawn ua, dangka-eng, dangka, dalsik, sing leh suang pathiante aphat uhi.
english: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

paite: Huai dak mah in mihing khutzungte ahong kilang guih a, kumpipa inpi baang pek tung, khawnvak koihna toh etdetna tak ahon gelh hi. Kumpipa'n laigelhtu khut bang tan hiam amu hi.
english: In the same hour came forth the fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the lampstand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

paite: Huai lai in kumpipa mel ahong lamdang a, angaihtuahnate'n amah apatausakta hi; akhut akhe akipzouta kei a, akhukte akisat tuah nomnom uhi.
english: Then the king’s face was changed in him, and his thoughts troubled him; and the joints of his thighs were loosened, and his knees struck one against another.

paite: Bum mite, Kaldai mite leh aisan mite hon pi un chi in nakpitak in kumpipa akikou hi. Kumpipa'n thu agen a, Babulon mipilte kiang ah, "Kuapeuh in hiai laigelh sim a, ahilhchetna hon ensak, puan sandup silhsak ahi ding a; angawng kimvel in dangka-eng khainiang a-ok ding a; gamsung ah vaihawmmi thumna ahi ding," achi hi.
english: The king cried aloud to bring in the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. The king spoke and said to the wise men of Babylon, Whoever shall read this writing, and show me its interpretation, shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa mipilte tengteng ahong lut ua; himahleh laigelh asim thei kei ua, ahilhchetna leng kumpipa atheisak thei kei uhi.
english: Then came in all the king’s wise men; but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Belshazzar apatau mahmah a; amah ah amel ahong lamdang a; akhawnbawlte alungzing uhi.
english: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his face was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa leh khawn-bawlte thu ziak in ankuangluina insung ah kumpinu ahong lut hi; kumpinu'n thu agen a, "Aw kumpipa, tangtawn in hing in, na ngaihtuahnate'n hon patausak kei henla, na mel leng lamdang kei hen.
english: Now the queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house: the queen spoke and said, O king, live forever; don’t let your thoughts trouble you, nor let your face be changed.

paite: Na gamsung a mi khat, amah a pathian siangthoute kha omna a-om a; na pa dam lai in vakna leh theihtheihna leh pilna, pathiante pilna bang, amah ah muh in a-om; kumpipa Nebukadnezzar, kumpipa, na pa'n, amah mitkhialdawi tawite leh bum mite, Kaldai mite leh aisan mite heutu in abawl hi.
english: There is a man in your kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, were found in him; and the king Nebuchadnezzar your father, the king, I say, your father, made him master of the magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and soothsayers;

paite: Lungsim hoihpen, theihna, theihtheihna, mangte hilhchetna, thugen haksa etsakna, ginlelhna hihvenna kumpipa'n Belteshazzar min asakpa, huai Daniel mah ah muh in a-om hi. Tu in Daniel sapsak in om henla, ama'n hilhchetna ensak hen," achi hi.
english: because an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and showing of dark sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let Daniel be called, and he will show the interpretation.

paite: Huan kumpipa ma ah Daniel ahon pi ua, Kumpipa'n thu agen a Daniel kiang ah, "Daniel, ka pa'n Judah gam a kipan Judah salmat hon pilut na hi hia?
heading: Daniel In Laigelh Ahilhchian
english: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. The king spoke and said to Daniel, Are you that Daniel, who are of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Judah?

paite: Nang ah pathian kha a-om a, vakna leh theihtheihna leh pilna hoihpen nang ah muh in a-om chih na tanchin ka za hi.
english: I have heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you, and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom are found in you.

paite: Tu in ka ma ah mipilte, bum mite ahon pilut ua, hiai laigelh sim a, ahilhchetna ka kiang a theisak ding in; himahleh huai thil hilhchetna a-ensak thei kei uhi.
english: Now the wise men, the enchanters, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known to me its interpretation; but they could not show the interpretation of the thing.

paite: Himahleh hilhchetnate na bawl thei a, ginlelhnate na bawlhoih thei chih na tanchin ka na za hi. Tu in laigelh na sim theih a, ahilhchetna na hon hilh theih leh puan sandup ka hon silhsak ding a; na ngawng kimvel in dangka-eng khi na ok ding a; gamsung ah vaihawmmi thumna na hi ding hi," achi hi.
english: But I have heard of you, that you can give interpretations, and dissolve doubts; now if you can read the writing, and make known to me its interpretation, you shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold about your neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

paite: Huchi in Daniel in adawng a kumpipa ma ah, "Na thilpiakte nangmah kiang ah hi zaw henla, na kipahmante midang kiang ah pe zaw in; ahi a, kumpipa kiang ah laigelh ka sim ding a, ahilhchetna amah ka theisak ding hi.
english: Then Daniel answered before the king, Let your gifts be to yourself, and give your rewards to another; nevertheless I will read the writing to the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

paite: Aw nang kumpipa, Tungnungpen Pathian in na pa Nebukadnezzar gam leh thupina, letna leh vaihawmna ahon pia hi.
english: You, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty:

paite: Huai amah apiak letna ziak in ama ah mi tengteng, namte, paute aling un alau ua; a-utut athat a, a-utut hinghawi in; a-utut akaithou a, a-utut asawnniam hi.
english: and because of the greatness that he gave him, all the peoples, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him: whom he would he killed, and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he raised up, and whom he would he put down.

paite: Himahleh alungtang ahong kisaktheih a, ki-uangsaktak a gamta a alungsim hihkhauh a a-om lai in, alaltutphah a kipan suan in a-om a, amah a kipan athupina alakheta hi.
english: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:

paite: Huan mite tapate a kipan hawlkhiak in a-om a; huchi in alungtang gamsate a bang a bawl in a-om a; bawngtalte bang a loupa a vak in a-om a, apumpi van daitui in akawt a; Tungnungpen Pathian in mihing gam ah vai ahawm a, a-ututte atung ah adingkhesak chih ahon theih matan.
english: and he was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the animals’, and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys; he was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky; until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he sets up over it whomever he will.

paite: "Huan nang atapa, Aw Belshazzar, hiai tengteng na theih in leng na lungtang na niamkhiak kei hi.
english: You, his son, Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this,

paite: Himahleh van Toupa dem in na kihihsang a; amau na ma ah toupa inn a tui-um belsuante na lasak a; nang leh na toupate, na zite leh na meite'n, huaite in uain na dawn uh a; bangmah mu thei lou, za thei lou, theithei lou dangka leh dangka-eng, dal, sik, sing leh suang pathiante bia in na phat a; Pathian akhut a na hatna omna leh na lampite tengteng neipa na pahtawi zaw kei hi.
english: but have lifted up yourself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before you, and you and your lords, your wives and your concubines, have drunk wine from them; and you have praised the gods of silver and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which don’t see, nor hear, nor know; and the God in whose hand your breath is, and whose are all your ways, you have not glorified.

paite: Huchi in amah a kipan huai khut banghiam tan sawl in ahong om a, hiai laigelh gelh in ahong omta hi.
english: Then was the part of the hand sent from before him, and this writing was inscribed.

paite: "Huan gelh a om laithu hiai ahi: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
heading: Baang A Thu Kigelh
english: This is the writing that was inscribed: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.

paite: Huai hilhchetna hiai ahi. MENE: Pathian in na gam asimta, abeisakta hi.
english: This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE; God has numbered your kingdom, and brought it to an end;

paite: TEKEL: bukna a buk in na om a, na chingzou kei hi.
english: TEKEL; you are weighed in the balances, and are found wanting.

paite: PERES: na gam hawm in a-om a, Mid mite leh Persia mite kiang ah piak ahita," achi hi.
english: PERES; your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

paite: Huchi in Belshazzar in thu apia a, dangka-eng khainiang angawng kimvel in a-oksak ua; gamsung a vaihawmmi athumna hi ding in amah tung ah thu apuang uhi.
english: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with purple, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.

paite: Huai zan mah in Kaldai kumpipa Belshazzar thah in a-om hi.
english: In that night Belshazzar the Chaldean King was slain.

paite: Mid mi Darias, kum sawmguk-le-nih a upa in gam atangta hi.
english: Darius the Mede received the kingdom, being about sixty-two years old.
